_comment: Shared packing list, rendered by the `packing` macro in src/itinerary.njk. Each trip's main.json picks `packingTags` from `modifiers`; base always shows. Trip-specific extras go in main.json `overrides.packing`.
base: Passports / IDs + 2 photocopies stored separately (see the Entry & Documents section)
Debit + 2 credit cards (call issuers re: travel); some local cash on arrival
Phone chargers, a multi-port USB brick, and a power bank for long transit days
Refillable water bottles for the whole family
Kids' comfort items, tablets pre-loaded with downloads for flights/drives
Small first-aid kit: pain/fever meds (adult + kids), band-aids, motion-sickness tabs, any prescriptions in original bottles
Light day pack + a foldable tote for beach/market runs
Copies of bookings (flights, lodging, car, tickets) saved offline

beach.label: Beach & water days
items: Swimsuits (2 each), quick-dry towels, rash guards for the kids
Water shoes — many Mediterranean beaches are pebble/rock
Goggles + a mesh bag for wet gear
Dry bag for phones/keys on boat days

hiking.label: Hiking & levada days
items: Broken-in trail shoes / light hikers for everyone
Daypack with rain shell — mountain weather turns fast
Headlamp (Madeira levada tunnels are dark and wet)

heat.label: Hot-weather (June sun)
items: Sun hats and UV sunglasses for all
Light, breathable long sleeves for midday sun protection
Electrolyte tabs — easy to under-hydrate with kids in the heat

rain.label: Rain / changeable weather
items: A spare set of dry clothes in the day pack

domestic.label: US domestic notes
items: No adapters needed; standard US plugs
TSA-friendly liquids; REAL ID to fly
